sources.label: authored-in-recovery
sources.note: compileObixScriptSetup on the shared core of @obinexusltd/obix-compiler-script, the OBIX diagnostic vocabulary of <script setup> (the compiler macros, the props destructure, type resolution), tests and README. No Vue source was copied or forked: the official compiler is reached through @obinexusltd/obix-compiler-script (@vue/compiler-sfc 3.5.43, pinned by obix-vue.json), so this package declares no Vue-family dependency of its own.

notes: The artifact is a frontend artifact (Vue's compiled setup module, binding metadata and Babel AST), not the semantic authority of OBIX: the canonical DOP IR is (D-44).
The corpus is tests/corpus/vuets (pairs of byte-identical .vue / .obix fixtures); the oracle shared by the script stages is tests/vuets/oracle.mjs.
